name: prodready
description: Takes a project from localhost to production and proves each step: finds hidden local dependencies, packs it into a container, boots it from a fresh copy of the code, writes a deploy manual tested by an agent with no context, deploys to servers or platforms, and checks the live URL. Includes a 13-area production-readiness check with parallel auditors, and a fix mode.

interface.shortDescription: From localhost to production, proven at every step
